What you are looking at

One row per rep. The grey row above each group is the team (with the team leader's name), and the last row is the total. Numbers are month to date, from the 1st to the latest data day.

  • Click a column header to sort (again to reverse, a third time to reset). Teams are sorted by their total.
  • Click a team row to collapse or open it.
  • Use Columns to hide or add columns, and the search box or team filter to find someone.

What the colors mean

Colors appear on rate and achievement columns only (for example Show-up %, Leads → Paid, Basic ach.).

GreenYellowRedGrey
44%31%22%38%
  • Green: at or above the reference.
  • Yellow: below it, but within 20%.
  • Red: more than 20% below it.
  • Grey number, no color: too few cases to judge (see below).

The example uses a reference of 36%.

What the reference is

Rates (App. %, Show-up %, Show-up → Paid, Leads → Paid, SOP completion)
The average for that column: all of the region's numerator divided by all of its denominator (for example all show-ups ÷ all booked).
Achievement (Basic ach., Activity achievement)
The share of the month that has passed. After of days that is , so a rep at or more is on pace.

When there is no color

  • Small samples. Under 20 leads or booked, or under 10 show-ups (5 tasks for SOP), a rate swings too much to judge, so the number stays grey.
  • Counts (Leads, Booked, Show-up, Paid, Cash, Unit price) have no fair benchmark and are not fully in a rep's control, so they are plain numbers. Cash is judged through its achievement column.
  • Team and total rows are summaries and carry no color.

The Channels tab

Pick a metric and compare it across the NonFunnel and Funnel views.

  • The blue row at the top is the healthy reference: the average for that view.
  • Each cell is colored against its own view's reference, never against another view.
  • NonFunnel is the main performance view. Funnel is a separate lead source with its own rules, so the two do not add up to each other.

Terms

Booked (App.)
Leads that got an appointment. App. % = Booked ÷ Leads.
Show-up %
Show-ups ÷ Booked.
Show-up → Paid / Leads → Paid
Paid orders ÷ Show-ups, and paid orders ÷ Leads.
Unit price
Cash ÷ paid orders.
Basic ach.
Cash ÷ the rep's Basic target for the month.
NonFunnel / Funnel
Two lead sources: the main performance view and the funnel view. Each follows its own rules.
Activity goal
Monthly service and lead-activity target per rep, with the latest day's activity.
